content:
After analysis and deliberation by the Jury of the 2024 Sustainability in the Built Environment Award, it was decided to award the honour in the Circularity Category to the following Finalist:

And the winner is… Grupo Casais!

Watch the video of the winning project here.

Para além do Grupo Casais, foram finalistas nesta categoria as seguintes entidades: BONGREEN, Costa Almeida,  Projeto CircOyster do Instituto Superior Técnico, Construções Pragosa e  Brisa.

BUILT CoLAB would like to thank all the organisations that applied!

We would like to remind you that this was the second edition of this initiative, which aims to promote and recognise good practices used in Portugal in the AEC sector, as well as to continue to raise awareness among industry and public institutions of the need for knowledge and innovation in the field of sustainability and circularity in the built environment.

The jury, to whom BUILT CoLAB would like to thank for their collaboration, was made up of representatives of leading institutions on the subject in Portugal who have contributed to its implementation and evolution at national level: Fernando de Almeida Santos, President of the Order of Engineers, Marlene Roque, Member of the National Board of Directors of the Order of Architects, Ana Cristina Carrola, Member of the Board of Directors of APA, Fernando Batista, President of IMPIC, Manuel Reis Campos, President of AICCOPN, Laura Caldeira, President of LNEC, Jorge Nandim de Carvalho, Member of PTPC, and Rita Moura, President of BUILT CoLAB (President of the Jury).
